message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
p.write_text('[{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":145,"var":"Data/Size","code":"fuzz_add_reader(ctx, Data, Size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped in a synthetic reader and become the source for all subsequent card reads."},{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"fuzz_reader_transmit","line":98,"var":"chunk","code":"fuzz_get_chunk(reader, &chunk, &chunk_size);","note":"The synthetic reader returns attacker-controlled APDU response bytes and status words to the card stack."},{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/card-cac.c","function":"cac_select_pki_applet","line":1698,"var":"index","code":"r = cac_select_pki_applet(card, index);","note":"The CAC initialization path selects a PKI applet before reading the first certificate, so the fuzzed reader controls which certificate is cached."},{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/card-cac.c","function":"cac_read_binary","line":562,"var":"cert_ptr/cert_len","code":"if (tag == CAC_TAG_CERTIFICATE) { cert_len = len; cert_ptr = val_ptr; }","note":"The CAC parser extracts certificate bytes from attacker-controlled TLV data and stores the length for later copying."},{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/card-cac.c","function":"cac_read_binary","line":613,"var":"priv->cache_buf_len-idx","code":"len = MIN(count, priv->cache_buf_len-idx);","note":"The final copy length is computed from attacker-influenced cache length and caller index without a lower-bound check on idx."},{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/opensc/src/libopensc/card-cac.c","function":"cac_read_binary","line":614,"var":"&priv->cache_buf[idx]","code":"memcpy(buf, &priv->cache_buf[idx], len);","note":"An oversized idx makes the source pointer point outside the cached certificate, causing the out-of-bounds read sink."}]')
PY
cp /workspace/repo-vul/candidate_trace.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
cd /workspace && bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc/src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 0.
